concerns.text: T002 consumes ≥3 real annotator rating files from data/raw/human_coding/ ('raise InsufficientAnnotatorsError if fewer than 3 distinct annotator files are present'), but no task produces those files. This is a consumer-before-producer gap: the declared execution order T001→T002 cannot run end-to-end because T002's primary input is an orphan artifact with no producer task anywhere in the list.

T003 reads versioned parameters from config/manipulation.yaml, but no task creates or validates that config file. Same for T006's config/pre_registration.yaml (T006 raises PreRegistrationError if missing, yet no task establishes it as VERIFIED). Both are consumed inputs with no producer task; the pipeline as ordered will fail at T003.

T005 reads 'the real responses from data/processed/responses.csv', but T004 only builds the randomization/logging engine plus a pilot integration test; no task covers actual participant recruitment/data collection producing the full real response file T005–T009 depend on. The dependent-variable data flow has a missing producer between T004 and T005.

T007–T009 carry no [US] tag while T001–T006 do. T007–T008 belong to US3's reporting scope; the user-story grouping (independently shippable units) is inconsistent across the task list. Cosmetic re-tagging only.
